GOV-F-004-S144.title: Audit Log Schema & Contract Definition
GOV-F-004-S144.description: Define canonical audit log schema including trace_id, actor (GPT/Claude/system), event_type, timestamp, payload_hash, previous_hash, and metadata. Enforce schema via Pydantic models and ensure compatibility across GPT and Claude execution paths.
GOV-F-004-S144.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/tool_models (Pydantic patterns); Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py (structured audit expectations); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S145.title: Append-Only Storage Enforcement Layer
GOV-F-004-S145.description: Implement persistence layer guaranteeing append-only behavior (no update/delete operations) with hash chaining enforcement at write time. Reject any mutation attempts and log violations.
GOV-F-004-S145.evidence: Code/Shared/ChatHealthyMongoUtilities.py (write patterns); docs/adr/ADR-0010-safety-incident-logging.md (immutable logging precedent); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S146.title: Internal Audit Logging SDK / Write Interface
GOV-F-004-S146.description: Create a centralized logging interface used by GPT (brain_runner, gpt_reader) and Claude (FastAPI backend) to emit audit events consistently. Automatically attach trace_id, enforce schema, and route writes through append-only layer.
GOV-F-004-S146.evidence: Code/Shared/brain_runner.py (GPT execution flow); Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/infrastructure/debug_logger.py (existing logging baseline); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004
